Cameroon vs Angola: Watch Live Stream Online - World Cup 2026 Qualifier 13.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of a decisive 2026 FIFA World Cup qualification match, as Cameroon hosts Angola at the Stade Ahmadou Ahidjo in Yaoundé. For the hosts, this is the last chance to fight for a direct ticket to the World Cup, while the visitors have no remaining tournament motivation.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 13, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

Cameroon enters this match in second place in Group D with 18 points, trailing leaders Cape Verde by two points. To secure a direct spot at the World Cup, the 'Indomitable Lions' need not only their own victory but also for Cape Verde to drop points in their concurrent match against Eswatini. Marc Brys's team has been formidable at home, winning all four of their home fixtures in this qualifying campaign with a combined score of 13-0. Cameroon boasts the best attack and defense in the group, having scored 17 goals and conceded just 5.

Angola has already been mathematically eliminated from World Cup contention and will be playing solely for pride. The 'Palancas Negras' sit fourth in the group with 11 points. The team comes into the match on a two-game unbeaten streak, but they have yet to win on the road in this qualifying cycle, drawing all four of their away matches. In their last game, Angola showed character by coming back from 2-0 down to draw 2-2 with Eswatini.

Head-to-Head History

The head-to-head record between these teams is quite balanced. In 16 meetings, Cameroon has won 6 times, Angola has won twice, and 8 matches have ended in a draw. The reverse fixture in this qualifying campaign, played in June 2024, ended in a 1-1 draw. Notably, six of the last seven encounters between the sides have seen under 2.5 goals scored.

Cameroon vs Angola Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider Cameroon the clear favorites. Their immense motivation, powerful home form, and superior quality should lead the hosts to victory.

  • Likely Outcome: A comfortable victory for Cameroon.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering Cameroon's solid defensive record at home and the low-scoring nature of most of their head-to-head clashes, a bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' appears highly probable.
  • Key Factor: Cameroon needs a win to keep their hopes of finishing first alive, whereas Angola has nothing to play for. Cameroon's perfect home record (100% wins) versus Angola's away record (100% draws) is a telling statistic.

Tune into the Cameroon vs Angola live stream on tutsport.net and follow the dramatic conclusion to qualifying Group D!

Join us for the live broadcast of a historic 2026 FIFA World Cup qualification match, as Cape Verde hosts Eswatini. For the home side, a victory in this encounter means securing their first-ever direct qualification to the World Cup finals.

Cape Verde stands on the brink of a historic achievement. The 'Blue Sharks' are at the top of Group D, two points ahead of Cameroon going into the final matchday. The team is in impressive form, remaining unbeaten in their last eight games. In the previous round, Cape Verde showed great character by coming back from 3-1 down to secure a 3-3 draw away against Libya. A win against the group's underdog will guarantee their spot at the 2026 World Cup.

Eswatini is enduring a dismal qualifying campaign. The team sits at the bottom of the group, having failed to win any of their nine matches - three draws and six losses. Their overall winless streak has extended to 18 matches across all competitions. In their last game, the 'King's Shield' let a 2-0 lead slip against Angola, eventually drawing 2-2. The team has no tournament motivation and will only be playing for pride.

Head-to-Head History

The head-to-head record is entirely in favor of Cape Verde. In five previous meetings, the Blue Sharks have recorded three wins and two draws, never losing. Furthermore, Eswatini has failed to score against Cape Verde in the last four consecutive encounters. The reverse fixture in this qualifying campaign ended in a comfortable 2-0 victory for Cape Verde.

Cape Verde vs Eswatini Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider Cape Verde the overwhelming favorites. The vast difference in quality, the immense motivation of the hosts, home-field advantage, and the visitors' poor form leave Eswatini with virtually no chance.

Join us for the live broadcast of a crucial 2026 FIFA World Cup qualification match, as Wales hosts Belgium at the Cardiff City Stadium. This encounter is of decisive importance for both teams in their fight for a direct spot at the World Cup, with just one point separating the rivals in Group J.

Match Preview and Team Form

After a somewhat shaky start, Wales is back in contention for World Cup qualification. The Dragons have lost three of their last four matches, but two of those defeats came in friendly games against Canada 0-1 and England 0-3. In competitive home matches, the Welsh have been unbeaten since March 2024, securing four wins and one draw. The situation in the group requires Craig Bellamy's team to perform at their absolute best.

Belgium, once considered the group favorite, complicated their task by drawing 0-0 with North Macedonia in the last round. Nevertheless, Belgium has an impressive record in World Cup qualifiers, having not lost since 2009.

The history between these teams includes 18 matches, with a slight advantage for Belgium: 8 wins to Wales' 5, with 5 draws. Belgium is unbeaten in their last five encounters with Wales - 3 wins and 2 draws. The reverse fixture in this qualifying campaign was a thriller that ended in a 4-3 victory for Belgium. Notably, Wales is unbeaten in their last three home matches against Belgium - 1 win and 2 draws.

Wales vs Belgium Prediction

Experts favor Belgium, but a hard-fought contest is expected. Belgium's inconsistent away form and Wales' traditionally resilient performances at home promise a tense match.

The head-to-head record strongly favors Germany. The Germans have won 10 of the last 11 encounters. The last defeat against Northern Ireland dates back to 1983, while the last draw occurred in 1996. In the reverse fixture of this qualifying campaign in September 2025, Germany came from behind to win 3-1.

North Macedonia vs Kazakhstan: Watch Live Stream Online - World Cup 2026 Qualifier 13.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of a 2026 FIFA World Cup qualification match, as North Macedonia hosts Kazakhstan at the Toše Proeski National Arena in Skopje. This is an important match for the hosts in their pursuit of a top spot in the group, while the visitors will aim to break their poor run of form and secure some points.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 13, 2025, 18:45 UTC (21:45 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

The North Macedonia national team has shown consistent performance in the current qualifying cycle and is among the leaders in Group J. In their recent matches, the Macedonians have performed well, securing a 0-0 draw with Belgium and a convincing 5-0 victory over Liechtenstein. The team is known for its solid defense, especially at home, where they have kept clean sheets in recent games.

Kazakhstan, on the other hand, is going through a difficult period. The team has lost most of its matches in the qualifying tournament and is situated in the lower part of the group standings. Kazakhstan's away form has been particularly poor, with defeats in the majority of their recent matches on the road. Despite a recent confident win against Liechtenstein, it will be extremely challenging for Talgat Baysufinov's side to compete against a motivated opponent in Skopje.

Head-to-Head History

The head-to-head record is entirely in favor of North Macedonia. The Macedonians have won both previous encounters. In the first leg of the current qualifying round in June 2025, North Macedonia secured a narrow 1-0 away victory. They also recorded a win in a friendly match in 2021 4-0.

North Macedonia vs Kazakhstan Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider North Macedonia the clear favorite for the upcoming match. Their home-field advantage, current form, and head-to-head statistics all point towards a victory for the hosts.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for North Macedonia.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering North Macedonia's strong defense and Kazakhstan's struggles in attack, especially in away games, a bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' appears highly probable.
  • Key Factor: The organized play and strong home form of the Macedonians versus the extremely poor away performances of Kazakhstan.
